_comment: Pinned third-party binaries. Hashes are SHA256 of the exact vendored builds this app was tested with (vendored 2026-06-10, frozen 2026-08-16). Build-Runtime.ps1 verifies bin/*.exe against these hashes and refuses to package a mismatch. To upgrade a tool: replace the exe in bin/, test the app end-to-end, then update the hash here in the same commit.
